sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB lending for business purpose to an MSE, RBI’s current rule says no pre-payment charges may be levied on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.
RBI’s current rule also says that, in cases other than those covered by that prohibition, pre-payment charges, if any, must be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
The sanction letter states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the amount prepaid, but the sanctioned amount or limit is not provided in the evidence.

Because the sanctioned amount is missing, compliance cannot be determined from the provided evidence; the relevant RBI rule may prohibit the charge if the loan is up to ₹50 lakh, or allow charges only if they follow the UCB’s approved policy.

missing.searched: Checked the sanction letter evidence and RBI applicability findings for the loan amount threshold tied to the current UCB pre-payment-charge rule.
